Join Winter of Code Social 2025!

Winter of Code Social is a three-month open-source program from November 1, 2025 to January 31, 2026. It brings together students, developers, and mentors to build real projects, learn new skills, and grow as a community.

If you want to get hands-on experience, meet people who love to build, and see your ideas come to life, this is for you. You can join as a contributor, mentor, or project admin and be part of something that makes learning real and fun.
